about.title: About me
about.intro: My name is Wilson Javier Simbaña Ganazhapa. I am a software developer passionate about video game development and web applications.
about.description: I consider myself a curious person who enjoys understanding how things work and taking on new challenges.
about.description2: I currently work on web and software development projects using technologies such as Angular and .NET. In addition to web development, I have worked on video game projects using engines such as Unreal Engine and Unity, experiences that have allowed me to develop a more creative and different perspective on programming.

Unwoven.title: Unwoven
Unwoven.description: Action twin-stick shooter published on Steam.
Unwoven.details: Master's thesis project developed in Unreal Engine. My main responsibilities included automating the game executable generation process, implementing character abilities and movement, developing the animation system, creating a circular shader, and optimizing resources.

emusk.title: E-mask
emusk.description: Comedy-themed video game published on itch.io.
emusk.details: Project developed during the Madrid Global Game Jam 2026 using Unity. My main responsibilities included implementing the camera and character movement, as well as developing the HUD.

GGTrack.description: Web application for rating and managing video games.
GGTrack.details: Web application focused on user management, video game ratings, and creating and managing wishlists.
